tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// blo sbyong spyi spungs don gyi man ngag ces bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun chen po dam pa rgya gar gyis gsungs pa'i blo sbyong spyi spungs zhes bya ba'i don gyi man ngag rgyal ba'i sras po mi ldog sa thob cing*// chos nyid bden pa mngon sum gzigs gyur pa// brtse ba'i bdag nyid gzhan don lhur len pa'i// dam pa rgya gar zhabs pad spyi bos mchod// blo sbyong spyi spungs zhes bya ba 'di la don lnga ste/ snying rje gsum gyi gzhi 'dings/ 'jug ldog lag len gsum gyis lam gyi dngos gzhi la 'jug tshul/ kun rdzob kun kyi cha sgom pa'i tshul/ stong nyid kyi lta bas rgyas gdab pa/ rjes bsngo ba smon lam gyis mjug bsdu ba'o// dang po la gsum/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'o// dang po/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje sgom tshul la'ang dmigs pa dang*/ rnam pa gnyis las/ dang po dmigs pa ni/ rigs drug gi sems can gyi sdug bsngal te/ dmyal ba'i sems can la/ tsha ba'i dmyal ba na/ yang sos/ thig nag bsdus 'joms/ ngu 'bod/ ngu 'bod chen po/ tsha ba/ rab tu tsha ba/ mnar med pa'i dmyal ba na sdug bsngal mtha' yas pas yongs su gdung bar byed la/ grang ba'i dmyal ba na/ a chu zer ba dang*/ kye hud zer ba dang*/ so tham tham pa dang*/ chu bur can dang*/ chu bur brdol ba can dang*/ pad+ma ltar gas pa dang*/ pad+ma ltar cher gas pa dang*/ ut+pal ltar gas pa ste/ grang bas nyen pas shin tu sdug bsngal lo// yi dwags rnams la/ phyi'i sgrib pa can dang*/ nang gi sgrib pa can dang*/ phyi nang gnyis ka'i sgrib pa can te/ zas skom mi mthong ba dang*/ zos nas me lcer gyur nas lus 'tshig pa dang*/ phyi nang gnyis ka'i gnod pas shin tu sdug bsngal lo// dud 'gro rnams ni gti mug pas blang dor mi shes pa dang*/

gcig gis gcig za ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal lo// mi rnams ni/ skye ba dang*/ rga ba dang*/ na ba dang*/ 'chi ba la sogs pas sdug bsngal lo// lha ma yin rnams la 'thab rtsod dang*/ lha rnams kyang 'chi ltas dang*/ gnas 'og mar lhung ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal lo// 'di dag gis ni snying rje'i dmigs pa bstan to// gnyis pa rnam pa ni/ 'di dag sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'o// 'di ni sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje'o// gnyis pa chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje ni/ sems can 'di dag skad cig re re bzhin 'jig pa'i ngang tshul can yin yang*/ de ma rtogs par rtag par 'dzin pa'i khyad par dmigs yul du byas nas/ de sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'o// gsum pa dmigs pa med pa'i snyeng rje ni/ 'di dag rang bzhin gyis stong pa yin yang*/ bden par 'dzin par dmigs nas sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'o// dang po ni so skye dang*/ gnyis pa ni nyan rang 'phags pa dang*/ gsum pa ni byang sems 'phags pa rnams la gtso bor ldan no// lam nyams su len pa la rtsa ba snying rje gsum gal che/ dbu ma 'jug pa las kyang*/ thog mar snying rje la bstod pa'i gnad kyang 'di yin no// dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa yang snying rje chen po'i mthu yin/ bar du bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs gsog pa yang snying rje chen po'i mthu yin/ tha mar sangs rgyas nas gzhan don du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'ang snying rje chen po'i mthu yin pa'i phyir ro// snying rje sbyong ba'i tshul ni/ dang po nye ba dang*/ de nas bar pa dang*/ tha ma dgra la dmigs te bsgom mo// 'byong ba'i tshad ni/ sems can gang mthong dang*/ dgra la'ang snying rje rtsol med du skye na 'byong ba'i tshad do// snying rje gsum gyis gzhi 'dings pa bstan zin to// gnyis pa 'jug ldog lag len gsum gyis 'jug pa la/ dang po stong pa nyid la 'jug pa dang*/

dngos por 'dzin la ldog pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyud la sbyor zhing de la mnyam par bzhag pa'o// dang po stong pa nyid la 'jug tshul la/ phyi stong pa nyid dang*/ nang stong pa nyid dang*/ phyi nang gnyis ka stong pa nyid dang*/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni 'jug yul lo// dang po gsum bsgom pas ni chos can la sgro 'dogs gcod cing*/ tha mas ni chos nyid kyi don la bden 'dzin gcod pa'i phyir/ chos can dang chos nyid la bden 'dzin chod pas bden 'dzin mtha' dag chod pa yin te/ chos can dang chos nyid gnyis po las ma gtogs pa'i chos gzhan med pa'i phyir ro// spyod 'jug las/ gang tshe dngos dang dngos med pa// blo yi mdun na mi gnas pa// de tshe rnam pa gzhan med pas// dmigs pa med pa'i rab tu zhi// zhes so// phyi stong pa nyid bsgom tshul ni/ phyi yul du gang snang thams cad sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ rmi lam lta bu dang*/ chu zla lta bu dang*/ 'ja' tshon lta bur snang tsam nyid nas blo la snang ba tsam du zad kyi/ ngo bo'am rang bzhin cung zad med par ting nge 'dzin bsgom par bya'o// nang stong pa nyid bsgom tshul ni/ nang lus su rtogs pa'i chos rnams kyang*/ de bzhin du bsgom par bya'o// 'di ni snang stong dbyer med du bsgom pa'i tshul lo// nang nyon mongs pa'i rnam rtog dang*/ lung ma bstan gyi rnam rtog dang*/ dge ba'i rnam rtog gang skyes thams cad bya ra ba'i tshul gyis rig par byas nas/ rtog pa gang skyes kyang*/ dang por gang nas byung*/ da lta gang na gnas/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis brtags nas mi dmigs pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o// 'di ni rig stong dbyer med du bsgom pa'i tshul lo// chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom par bstan pa na/ stong pa nyid du bden no snyam pa'i rtogs pa skyes na de'ang gzhom par bya ste/ klu sgrub kyis/ kun rtog thams cad gzhom pa'i phyir// stong nyid bdud rtsi bstan par mdzad// gang la de la 'dzin yod pa// de ni khyod kyi smad par mdzad// ces pa dang*/

mdo las kyang*/ 'od srungs gang zag gi bdag tu lta ba ri rab tsam ni sla yi/ gang dag stong pa nyid du lta ba mngon pa'i nga rgyal can de ni de lta ma yin no// zhes so// de'i don rtsa ba shes rab las/ gang dag stong pa nyid lta ba// de dag bsgrub du med par gsungs// zhes so// bden pa 'gog pa'i rig pa ni/ rtsa ba shes rab las/ gal te stong min cung zad yod// stong pa'ang cung zad yod par 'gyur// mi stong cung zad yod min na// stong pa'ang yod par ga la 'gyur// zhes pa ste/ chos can med na de la brten pa'i chos nyid yod par ga la 'gyur/ zhes pa'o// gzhan yang chos nyid shes bya yin nam min// dang po ltar na/ shes byed med pa'i shes bya mi 'thad pas// shes byed la ltos dgos la/ chos gzhan la ltos nas 'jog dgos pa ni/ ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa'i don med pas rang bzhin med par grub bo// bstod tshogs las/ ma shes pas ni shes bya min// de med rnam par shes med pa// de phyir shes dang shes bya dag /rang bzhin med par khyod kyis gsungs// zhes so// 'jug ldog lag len gsum gyi lam gyi dngos gzhi la 'jug tshul bstan zin to// gsum pa kun rdzob thabs kyi cha bsgom pa'i tshul la/ rang gi dbugs phar 'gro ba'i dus su/ rang gi bde skyid dang dge ba thams cad sems can la thim par bsam/ dbugs tshur rngub pa'i dus su gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rnams rang la thim par bsam mo// 'di gnyis spel mar sbyang ba gces so// rin chen phreng ba las/ bdag la de dag sdig smin cing*// bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ces pa dang*/ phyir mi ldog gi rtags kyi skabs su/ bdag dang gzhan du brje ba nyid kyis gzhan gyi yul la yongs su bsngos pa'i sbyin pa la sogs pa dang*/ zhes so// bzhi pa stong pa nyid kyi lta bas rgyas gdab pa ni/ gtong len gnyis la spel mar sbyangs pa'i rjes su/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis legs par brtags pas/

ma rnyed pa'i don la yang dang yang du mnyam par 'jog par bya'o// spel mar bsgom pas ni/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po gsog la/ rjes kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis ni/ ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs par byed do// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pas sangs rgyas 'grub bo// lnga pa rjes bsngo ba smon lam gyis mjug bsdu ba ni/ tshogs gnyis kyi dge ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bas zin par byed pa gal che bas/ dge sbyor gyi thun re re'i rjes su'ang bsngo ba 'di shin tu gnad che'o// dam pa rgya gar gyi man ngag 'di gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos so// dam pa'i zhal nas legs 'ongs man ngag rin chen gter// mngon par brtson pa'i sbyor bas legs bsgrubs 'khor ba ru// skye ba gsum las lhag par mi sdod dam pas gsungs// de phyir 'di la rab tu 'bad pas 'jug par rigs// 'di sbyar las byung dge ba dri med des// mtha' yas sems can pha ma dang bcas pa'i// sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces rje btsun dam pa rgya gar nas brgyud pa'i blo sbyong spyi spungs kyi man ngag 'di ni rong ston chen po shes bya kun rig gis dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
